video.decoding_capability: Analog: 4 x 8MP Lite @ 8 or 4 x 720P @ 30; IP: 1 x 4K @ 15 or 4 x 720P @ 30

features: Supported analog inputs: AHD up to 8MP @ 15fps, TVI up to 8MP @ 15fps, CVI up to 8MP @ 15fps, CVBS
Analog smart by DVR: Ultra Motion Detection (UMD), Face Detection, SIP (Intrusion Detection, Cross Line Detection, Enter Area, Leave Area)
IP smart by IPC: Face Detection, SIP, Defocus Detection, Scene Change Detection, Object Removed, Object Left Behind, Auto Tracking, People Flow Counting
VCA search: Face Search, Behavior Search, People Counting Report
Downlink ONVIF (Profile S); ANR and NAS supported
Analog camera upgrade over coaxial cable
notes: Specifications come from the product page; the data sheet linked from that page is the HDVR164K-Q2V2-NCV sheet, not this model.
Channel modes: 4-ch analog (BNC) + 2-ch IP; maximum IP video input 6-ch.
Incoming bandwidth 40 Mbps, up to 48 Mbps after all analog channel conversion.
Audio inputs and outputs count the RCA connectors; the page also lists 4-ch BNC audio input and output (channel audio). Two-way audio works with an IP camera or specific analog cameras.
Dimensions converted from the stated 10.2" x 8.9" x 1.8".
